note: Queue Mail defers outgoing mail (for the mail IDs listed in queue_mail.settings:queue_mail_keys, matched with path.matcher so '*' and 'user_*' work) to the reliable 'queue_mail' queue, processed on cron by SendMailQueueWorker; failed sends retry up to 'threshold' (default 50) after 'requeue_interval' (default 10800s). Config keys: queue_mail_keys (default ''), queue_mail_queue_time (15), threshold (50), requeue_interval (10800), queue_mail_queue_wait_time (0). Configure route queue_mail.admin_settings. Medium/hard cases are grounded in the real queue_mail.settings config (config-based; not on flaky live mail delivery). Shipped default queue_mail_keys is '' (nothing queued) and threshold 50; restored explicitly.

evals.prompt: I installed Queue Mail but no emails are being queued. How do I actually tell it which emails to queue, and how do I queue every email the site sends?
evals.expected_output: Queue Mail queues nothing until you list mail IDs at /admin/config/system/queue_mail (config queue_mail.settings:queue_mail_keys, one per line). Wildcards are supported: use '*' to queue all mail, or e.g. user_* for all User module mail.

evals.prompt: Once Queue Mail has put emails in its queue, how and when do they actually get sent, and what Drush command processes them?
evals.expected_output: Queued mail is sent on cron by the SendMailQueueWorker (queue id 'queue_mail'). You can process it on demand with `drush queue:run queue_mail --time-limit=15` (the time limit matters because failed items are re-queued).

evals.prompt: Which hook does Queue Mail provide to alter or cancel an email right before it is actually sent from the queue?
evals.expected_output: hook_queue_mail_send_alter(array &$message) — invoked when a queued mail is dequeued and about to be sent. Set $message['send'] = FALSE to cancel it. It is like hook_mail_alter() but fires at send time.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, Queue Mail has been configured to queue some emails. Inspect the live configuration and state which mail IDs are being queued.
evals.expected_output: queue_mail_keys is 'user_*' (all User module mail) in queue_mail.settings (read via `drush config:get queue_mail.settings queue_mail_keys`).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, Queue Mail's retry behavior has been customized. Inspect the live configuration and state how many times it will retry sending a failed email before giving up (the retry threshold).
On this Drupal site, configure Queue Mail so that ALL emails the site sends are queued and delivered via cron rather than sent inline. Apply the change to the live configuration.
On this Drupal site, configure Queue Mail so that ONLY the user password-reset email (mail id user_password_reset) is queued, without queuing every email. Apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: queue_mail.settings:queue_mail_keys contains user_password_reset (or a wildcard such as user_* that matches it) and is not '*'.
